jobs.prompt: Two real bugs found while starting a wide wave on project-swarm (tools: tools/scope-loop.mjs, tools/scope-commands.mjs, tools/ticket-manifest.mjs, tools/acceptance.mjs, tools/swarm/core-51.mjs). BUG A: `swarm go --scope` fails with 'Missing context: tests/orchestrator-handoff.test.mjs'. Ticket T-0144 (not ready, depends on T-0142) lists as context a file that is T-0142's own not-yet-built output; wave preparation validates context files of tickets that are NOT in the current wave (or that are not startable yet), and the manifest validation (core-51.mjs around the 'Missing context' failure, which only tolerates a missing file when ANOTHER JOB IN THE SAME MANIFEST outputs it) refuses the whole wave. Fix at the right layer: when the wave manifest is built from ledger tickets, include only tickets that are startable now (status ready, every dependency done); tickets that are not startable never reach validation; and for a startable ticket whose context file is missing because it is the declared output of a ticket that is not done (still pending), drop that context entry for this run with a warning 'context <file> belongs to <ticket> (pending), dropped for this run' instead of failing the wave. A context file missing for any other reason still fails as today. BUG B: a ticket in review whose acceptance review cannot start keeps failing with 'acceptance review start failed (n/2): Manifest requires version: 1 and 1-5000 jobs' even after the resume-manifest fix (#296, tools/scope-loop.mjs queueResumeReviews and handleAcceptanceReviewStartFailure): reproduce in a test with a ticket whose acceptance review manifest ends up with ZERO jobs (for example every acceptance line is already met by a passing test, or the ticket owns no reviewable files, or the manifest builder returns an empty job list): in that case there is nothing to review, so mark the acceptance review as skipped with a note (same skip rule the cross-worktree skip uses) and move the ticket on (to done if its tests passed) instead of calling the review runner with an empty manifest or counting a start failure; if the real cause turns out to be different, find it by reproducing with the ledger shape (status review, no review run, files present) and fix that cause, and say so in your final summary. Also make validateManifest's generic error name the cause: 'Manifest requires version: 1 and 1-5000 jobs' must say whether the manifest was missing, unparseable, or had zero jobs. Regression tests in tests/wave-prep-context.test.mjs (A: a pending sibling output is dropped with a warning, a truly missing file still fails, non-startable tickets never reach validation; B: zero-job acceptance manifest is skipped with a note, no start-failure counting, clear validate error messages). Keep tests/scope-loop*.test.mjs, tests/acceptance*.test.mjs, tests/ticket-manifest*.test.mjs passing.
